title: anthemis tinctoria subsp. parnassica
intro: Anthemis tinctoria subsp. parnassica, commonly known as Parnassian chamomile or mountain chamomile, is a subspecies of Anthemis tinctoria, a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as soothing anxiety and insomnia, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Parnassian chamomile include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate digestive issues and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
